Hi Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- High-level fit: LumenHealth is focused on low-latency inference for clinical summarization and embeddings for search; your primary constraints are P99 latency < 200ms for short responses and strict VPC/networking controls.
- Next step we recommend: a 60–90 minute technical immersion with our ML/Infra team to walk architecture, latency/cost tradeoffs, and a short runthrough of an integration plan.

Can you confirm:
1) Which of these weeks works best for your team (we'll reserve 60–90m): Tue/Wed mornings (PST) Mar 23–24, or Thu/Fri Mar 25–26?
2) Who will attend from LumenHealth (names + roles) so we can bring the right folks (serving/runtime engineer, security lead, solutions architect)?
3) Any nonstandard topics to include (PII redaction, KMS/HSM, SOC 2 evidence)?

Agenda we propose (draft):
- 5m intros
- 20m product + serving runtime overview
- 25m infra deep dive (routing, batching, quantization, SLOs)
- 20m integration & security Q&A
- 10m next steps / action items

Attachments: redwood-prod-arch-overview.pdf (arch sketch), pre-demo-checklist.xlsx (short checklist for attendee roles and pre-reqs).

If you share 2–3 candidate slots I will lock the ML/Infra leads and send a calendar invite with the draft agenda.

Thanks,
